claims.text: Oxytocin 10 IU IV or IM = first-line for uterine atony (FIGO)
claims.quote: Oxytocin: The International Federation of Gynecology and Obstetrics recommends giving oxytocin 10 international units (IU) IV or intramuscularly (IM) first-line for uterine atony if not administered prophylactically.

claims.text: Up to 25% of PPH pts need additional uterotonics
claims.quote: While oxytocin is recommended routinely at delivery, additional uterotonic medications are necessary in up to 25% of patients with PPH.

claims.text: Methylergonovine 200 μg IM or IV; relatively CI in HTN
claims.quote: Methylergonovine 200 μg IM or IV is typically recommended but is relatively contraindicated in patients with hypertension.

claims.text: Carboprost: CI in severe hepatic, renal or CV dz; may cause bronchospasm in asthma
claims.quote: Carboprost is contraindicated in severe hepatic, renal, and cardiovascular disease and may cause bronchospasm in patients with asthma.

claims.text: Misoprostol (PGE1 analog): slower onset; PO, SL, PR or buccal
claims.quote: Misoprostol: Misoprostol is a prostaglandin E1 analog with a more prolonged onset of action than other uterotonics, depending on the administration route, which includes oral, sublingual, rectal, or buccal routes.

claims.text: TXA: ⍉uterotonic; inhibits fibrinolysis; used w uterotonics
claims.quote: Tranexamic acid: Tranexamic acid (TXA) is not uterotonic but inhibits fibrinolysis and is frequently used with uterotonic medications.

claims.text: TXA 1 g IV over 10 min if initial medical mgnt ineffective
claims.quote: Tranexamic acid can also be used if initial medical management is ineffective (1 g IV over 10 minutes).

claims.text: Bleeding deaths ↓, esp when given w.in 3 h of birth (WOMAN trial)
claims.quote: Death due to bleeding was significantly reduced in women given tranexamic acid (155 [1·5%] of 10 036 patients vs 191 [1·9%] of 9985 in the placebo group, risk ratio [RR] 0·81, 95% CI 0·65-1·00; p=0·045), especially in women given treatment within 3 h of giving birth (89 [1·2%] in the tranexamic acid group vs 127 [1·7%] in the placebo group, RR 0·69, 95% CI 0·52-0·91; p=0·008).
claims.locator: WOMAN Trial Collaborators. Effect of early tranexamic acid administration on mortality, hysterectomy, and other morbidities in women with post-partum haemorrhage (WOMAN). Lancet. 2017;389(10084):2105-2116 (abstract, PubMed)
